feature_definition.topology: stroke count, valid stroke count, points per stroke, stroke length statistics
feature_definition.geometry: bounding box, aspect ratio, path length, displacement, straightness
feature_definition.motion: velocity, acceleration and temporal movement statistics
feature_definition.direction: direction changes, turn angles and directional endpoints
feature_definition.normalized_shape: arc-length normalized stroke representation used as a structural feature, not a final signature
feature_definition.stroke_relationships: stroke ordering and per-stroke feature sequence

knowledge.important_boundary: This artifact is a deterministic feature representation, not a trained generative model.
